description: List every check region of the platform, to show the user where checks can run. Returns regions, each with code (what a regions argument takes), display_name, city, country_code, group and group_display_name. The organization may use only some of them: to choose regions for a monitor read limits.allowed_regions and max_regions from get_plan_usage instead. For one monitor's per-region timings use get_response_time_by_region.
name: list_regions
title: List check regions
